identity.name: Coastal Flats - Downtown Crown
identity.notes: The official brand site distinguishes Downtown Crown from Fairfax Corner and Tysons Corner. Only the location-specific Gaithersburg PDFs and ordering store were used.

sources.excerpt: The official brand homepage lists three distinct locations and identifies Downtown Crown at 135 Crown Park Ave, Gaithersburg, MD 20878.
The official Downtown Crown page confirms the Gaithersburg address, phone number, hours, four current location-linked menu PDFs, and exact online-ordering store.
The visually reviewed four-page Downtown Crown lunch PDF publishes complete lunch food, kids, side, and dessert offerings; alcohol-only pages were excluded from POC scope.
The visually reviewed four-page Downtown Crown dinner PDF publishes complete dinner food, kids, side, and dessert offerings, including Jambalaya Pasta and Crab Cake & Filet Mignon.

The two-page official lunch guide lists gluten-sensitive presentations and states that shared cooking and preparation areas can allow gluten-containing foods to contact other products and that no item is guaranteed completely gluten free.
The two-page official dinner guide lists gluten-sensitive presentations and repeats the explicit shared-preparation gluten cross-contact warning and no-guarantee language.
The restaurant-linked ordering store binds to 135 Crown Park Avenue and exposes nine current in-scope categories plus a non-product Utensils utility category.

Fresh official-domain, document, vendor, and targeted searches reconfirmed the Downtown Crown location and current official gluten-sensitive guides. Sibling Fairfax and Tysons menus and stale third-party menus were excluded.

attempts.query: Inspect the Coastal Flats homepage and Downtown Crown location navigation for Gaithersburg identity, menu links, allergy guidance, and ordering links.
attempts.outcome: The official site separated Downtown Crown from Fairfax and Tysons and linked current lunch, dinner, gluten-sensitive lunch/dinner PDFs plus the exact ordering store.

attempts.query: Inspect and visually render every current PDF linked by the Gaithersburg Menus navigation, including both gluten-sensitive guides.
attempts.outcome: All 12 pages across four PDFs were rendered and reviewed. The gluten-sensitive lunch and dinner documents are current official allergen material and carry explicit shared-preparation gluten cross-contact and no-guarantee language.

attempts.query: Inspect the exact restaurant-linked Coastal Flats: Gaithersburg ordering store and all current categories.
attempts.outcome: The vendor confirmed 135 Crown Park Avenue and exposed 58 in-scope product rows across nine categories before same-name service presentations were separated and repeated menu products consolidated. Utensils was excluded as a utility.

attempts.outcome: Search reconfirmed the exact official location, PDFs, and linked vendor. No broader product-by-allergen matrix was found beyond the official gluten-sensitive guides; sibling and stale third-party catalogs were excluded.

matrixSearch.notes: Official allergen material was found: two location-linked gluten-sensitive guides. They are not interpreted as proof of gluten absence; their explicit shared-preparation warning is preserved as may-contain gluten evidence for the listed presentations.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: During normal operations involving shared cooking and preparation areas, gluten-containing food can contact other food products; the restaurant cannot guarantee any menu item is completely gluten free.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Applied only as mayContain gluten to products presented on at least one current gluten-sensitive menu. It is not an absence claim.

findings.summary: The verified record is the Downtown Crown restaurant at 135 Crown Park Ave in Gaithersburg. Fairfax Corner and Tysons Corner catalogs were not merged.

The current catalog consolidates 13 complete lunch, dinner, gluten-sensitive, and linked-ordering surfaces into 63 unique products while preserving category-specific Fish Fingers and size-specific sliders/filets.

All 55 frozen products remain current, but the projection omitted eight current products: Community Bread Basket, Field Greens, Caesar, Grilled Short Smoked Salmon, Hickory Grilled Absolutely Fresh Fish, the full-size Fish Fingers entree, Pecan Crusted Trout, and Warm White Chocolate Bread Pudding.

Official gluten-sensitive lunch and dinner guides were found. Their shared-preparation warning is preserved as direct gluten cross-contact evidence; the listed options are not marked categorically gluten free.

proposedChanges: Keep the record strictly scoped to Coastal Flats Downtown Crown in Gaithersburg.
Replace the 55-product under-extracted projection with the 63-product union of current lunch, dinner, gluten-sensitive, and exact linked-ordering surfaces.
Preserve distinct kids and entree Fish Fingers plus selectable slider and filet sizes instead of merging materially different ordering presentations.
Apply the official shared-preparation warning as may-contain gluten only to products listed on current gluten-sensitive menus; do not publish categorical gluten-free guarantees.
